    • posteriorHCA

    Compare cohort log(μ) estimates to an HCA posterior baseline

    compare_cohort_to_hca.Rd

    Convenience wrapper around [summarize_posterior_draws()] and [welch_test_means()]. Summarises `hca_draws` once, then runs the Welch comparison for each row of `cohort_estimates`. Does not implement Welch mathematics itself.

    compare_cohort_to_hca(
  cohort_estimates,
  hca_draws,
  alternative = c("two.sided", "greater", "less")
)

    Arguments

    cohort_estimates

    Data frame from [estimate_cohort_logmu()] with columns `log_mu`, `se`, and preferably `group`, `gene`, and `n`.

    hca_draws

    Numeric draws or a list from [expression_draws()] / [expression_baseline_draws()].

    alternative

    Passed to [welch_test_means()].

    Value

    A data frame with one row per cohort estimate, including `delta`, `se_diff`, `t_stat`, `df`, and `p_value`.

    See also

    [summarize_posterior_draws()], [welch_test_means()], [estimate_cohort_logmu()], [expression_baseline_draws()]
